name: Autism
overview: Scripture affirms that God is sovereign over all aspects of human life, including the ways He forms individuals with various abilities and challenges, as seen in His declaration that He makes the mute, deaf, seeing, and blind (Exodus 4:11). Jesus' welcoming of children and His teaching that the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these (Matthew 18:2; 19:14) highlight the special value and care God places on every child. God's plans for His people are always for their peace and hope (Jeremiah 29:11), and He promises to teach and guide all children (Isaiah 54:13), offering assurance that every life is purposefully made and lovingly sustained by Him.
